$comment: Shared vocabulary for the transit map. The JSON Schemas, the pipeline (transit_pipeline/vocab.py) and the app (src/data/vocab.ts) all read this file. docs/SCHEMA.md explains each term.

planned.label: Planned
planned.meaning: In an adopted plan or under study; no environmental clearance yet.

environmental.label: Environmental review
environmental.meaning: In environmental review, or cleared but without construction funding.

funded.label: Funded
funded.meaning: Environmentally cleared with construction funding committed; construction not started.

under_construction.label: Under construction
under_construction.meaning: Construction, including early works, under way.

opening.label: Opening
opening.meaning: Built and in testing, or an opening date announced by the agency.

geometry_confidence.surveyed: From OpenStreetMap, OpenHistoricalMap, GTFS or official GIS.
geometry_confidence.approximate: Reconstructed from text descriptions. Drawn dashed.

flags.opened_unsourced: No source found for the opening date; it is left null.
flags.closed_unsourced: No source found for the closing date; it is left null.
flags.expected_opening_unsourced: The agency's expected opening isn't recorded yet.
flags.status_unverified: Status not yet re-verified against official sources for this map.
flags.geometry_unverified: Geometry not yet checked against a second source.
flags.needs_manual_digitizing: Needs tracing by hand from a historic map.
flags.license_unclear: The source states no license; see DATA_LOG.md.
